description: Browse video, audio and 3D model choices, supported settings, voices and indicative Gold prices. All quote and generation operations already have fixed tools with complete input schemas; this optional catalogue does not define new operations or inputs. Each result links its fixed quote and execution tool names. With kind alone it is an index: every model, the operations (modes) it runs and its price at default settings. Pass mode for the models of one operation with their settings, sources and how to phrase the prompt (prompt_style and prompt_styles). Pass model for one model's settings, voices and prompt_rule; voice_query filters the voice list (at most 100 voices). kind model_3d lists the 3D create models with their options and the 3D tools (cleanup, uv, rig, animate, split) with the Tripo models they use and their Gold. Obtain the exact price from the corresponding quote tool.

mode.description: Optional operation of a video or audio fixed tool, such as image-to-video or music: lists only the models that run it, with their settings and sources for it.

model.description: Optional model name from the index: returns that model's supported settings, voices and sources.

voice_query.description: Optional text to filter the voice list of the chosen model (case-insensitive).

name: chargen_list_media_models
title: List media models
